01 SESSION NOTES

Agree the cut before you start the clock.

01

The episode edit

The €225 pilot includes a technician-led session and an edit of the switched video up to 30 finished minutes. Supply the intro and outro you want to use. One revision is included.

02

Clips for social media

A strong short clip usually answers one question. At the pilot rate of €35 each, we can cut a vertical excerpt around that moment. Agree the caption language and what names or technical terms need checking.

03

One package worked through

An edited episode at €225 plus three vertical clips at €35 each comes to €330 before any applicable VAT. Separate camera originals, extensive restructuring, translation and channel uploads need to be agreed in advance.

02 BEFORE YOU RECORD

Good questions.

What is the difference between a switched video and an edited episode?

The switched video keeps the angles the technician chose during recording. An episode edit is a later pass to trim and arrange the material within the agreed scope.

Can our editor take over?

Yes. List their requirements in your brief so we can confirm the file formats and any separate in-camera capture before the session.
